subject: Your December money reset (no spreadsheet spiral required)
text:
Hey Profyn crew,

December can turn into “wait, where did my money go?” season pretty fast. Before making a huge January plan, try a tiny reset.

THIS MONTH'S MONEY MOVE
For the next seven days, note what you spend. Your notes app is enough. Include the small stuff, then sort it into needs, things you enjoyed, and things you barely remember buying. No guilt trip. You're looking for a pattern you can actually change.

TRY THIS IN FIVE MINUTES
Pick one upcoming cost you want to be ready for. Write down the amount, the date, and one small step you can take this week. That step can be checking the price, setting a reminder, or saving an amount that fits your situation. Small progress still counts.

THE PROFYN CHECK-IN
Our podcast library is getting fresh recordings, with Seasons 1 and 2 on the way and Season 3 coming soon. Check the site for updates and the latest workshop schedule.
https://profyn.org/listen/
https://profyn.org/workshops/

A free tool if you want more structure: the CFPB's spending tracker is part of its Your Money, Your Goals toolkit.
https://www.consumerfinance.gov/consumer-tools/educator-tools/your-money-your-goals/toolkit/

You don't have to become a budgeting machine overnight. One useful habit is a solid start.

See you next month,
The Profyn team
